newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech 1997 budget deficit CZK 12.2 bln end-May.
newsitem.headline: Czech 1997 budget deficit CZK 12.2 bln end-May.

text.p: The Czech finance ministry said on Monday that the 1997 budget showed a deficit of 12.2 billion crowns at the end of May compared with a deficit of 12.0 billion crowns at the end of April.
CZECH STATE BUDGET JAN-MAY JAN-APRIL JAN-MAY 96
Note. All figures in billions of crowns, measuring through end of period listed.

The finance ministry said that revenue at the end of May 1997 showed a "gradual improvement" with nominal year-on-year revenue 5.5 percent higher for the first five months of the year, compared with a 4.7 percent increase, year-on-year, for the first four months.
Nominal expenditures for the first five months were up 8.4 percent, year-on-year, compared with 10.4 percent for the first four months.
